ALGS Split 2 Pro League Kicks Off!

ALGS Split 2 Pro League Kicks Off!

Year 6 of the ALGS pushes forward and into the next Split of the Pro League!

Last updated:

The ALGS is back for Split 2. Beginning August 21, 120 teams across the Americas, EMEA, APAC North, and APAC South will battle for 40 spots at the Split 2 Playoffs in Las Vegas, a share of the $500,000 USD prize pool, and critical Championship Points on the road to the ALGS Championship in Sapporo.

However, before we turn our attention to Split 2, a huge congratulations to UNLIMIT for winning the ALGS Split 1 Playoffs at the Esports World Cup. The match-point finals were some of the most tense in recent memory, and it was amazing to see a team from Japan win a global ALGS event for the first time!

Vegas is calling 

From October 29 through November 1, 2026, the ALGS Year 6 Split 2 Playoffs will bring 40 of the world’s top Apex Legends teams to Orleans Arena in Las Vegas for four days of competition. The complete list of Playoffs teams will be determined through the four regional Split 2 Pro Leagues, with every match helping decide which teams earn their place on the international stage.

Based on each region’s performance at the Split 1 Playoffs, the 40 Split 2 Playoffs berths have been allocated as follows. Each region’s Regional Finals winner will automatically qualify and will count toward the allocation shown below; the remaining berths will be awarded through the final Split 2 Pro League standings.

  • Americas: 15

  • APAC North: 10

  • APAC South: 8

  • EMEA: 7

Don’t forget that tickets for the Split 2 Playoffs are on sale now. Join us at Orleans Arena for four days of ALGS action, culminating in our iconic Match Point Finals on Sunday, November 1.

Get your tickets today and be there when the Split 2 Playoffs champion is crowned!

How Split 2 Works

Each region’s Split 2 Pro League includes 22 teams that retained their Pro League position following Split 1 and eight teams that earned their place through the Pro League Qualifier. The 30 teams are divided into three groups of 10 and compete in a triple round-robin Regular Season, with each group facing the other two groups three times.

Teams earn Pro League Points based on their performance in each series. After nine Regular Season match days, the top 20 teams in each region advance to the Regional Finals, which are played using the ALGS Match Point format.

The winner of each Regional Final automatically qualifies for the Split 2 Playoffs and counts toward that region’s total Playoffs allocation. The remaining Playoffs spots are awarded based on the final Split 2 Pro League standings.

POI Drafting and Legend Bans will continue to be in effect throughout Split 2, requiring teams to adapt their drop plans and Legend compositions from match to match.

The official Pro League roster transfer window will also open after Match Day 6, giving teams a defined opportunity to make roster changes before the final stretch of the split.

What’s at Stake

Across all four regions, teams will compete for a share of the $500,000 USD Split 2 Pro League prize pool ($125,000 per region), and valuable Championship Points toward qualification for the ALGS Championship.

Championship Points are the primary path to the ALGS Championship in Year 6.

32 Championship berths will be awarded through Championship Points, with the remaining eight (two per region) decided through the Last Chance Qualifier. As the final Pro League split of the year, every match in Split 2 could have a significant impact on the season-long Championship Points race.

ALGS Split 2 Pro League Schedule

The Split 2 Pro League runs across three consecutive weekends from August 21 through September 6. APAC South will hold its Regional Finals on Saturday, September 12, followed by the Americas, EMEA, and APAC North Regional Finals on Sunday, September 13.

How to watch the ALGS Split 2 Pro League

Make sure to tune in to the ALGS throughout the split! You can catch our official English broadcast on our Twitch and YouTube channels. 

We’re also excited that Multiview will be returning for Split 2, available across all four Pro League regions. The fully customizable tool lets you watch your favorite (or least favorite!) teams in their matches. You have access to their full communication, can watch up to 12 POVs at once, and can even follow the live standings throughout each game - so you can see exactly how the land lies at any given moment across the competition. 

For those of you who like to take in some of our watch parties, they can also be added to the multiview tool. Additionally, for those of you hosting your own watch parties, you can draw directly on streams in the tool to break down plays for your audience.

Remember, you can sign in to your Twitch Account via Multiview, so you can still earn Twitch Drops each day.

ALGS Split 2 Twitch Drops

It wouldn’t be an ALGS split without Twitch Drops - and we have a great selection this split. 

Each broadcast day will have an Apex Pack to offer, with two available for the Regional Finals. That’s a total of 11 across the split. There is also the new ‘Sushi Nessie’ weapon charm available throughout the split!

Don’t forget to link your EA and Twitch accounts to make sure you’re not missing out on these drops!
